what: A 3D object stands at the center of the panel (three.js: a glossy egg body with a petal crown, two goggles, two wings and a chain, or three furry petals). It turns its head ±26° left and right once every 14 seconds and bobs up and down once every 3.2 seconds. Around it a sentence ring (an uppercase text line repeated around the circumference), tilted 30° toward the screen and skewed −12°, spins straight once every 24 seconds. The ring has two layers, outer face and inner face, so text that turns to the back is not mirrored, and it is hidden when passing behind the object. A slogan ring circling the Hero mascot

options.ring: If 0, only the object without the ring (like the fuzzy petals in the services section)
options.shape: egg (default — egg body, petal tube, goggles) or petals (three furry petals)
options.y · ring-y: Moves the object and ring up and down (world units, screen height about 4.1), default 0 · 0 — in the original hero the object is cut off at the bottom of the screen and the ring center sits low on the body (y −.55 · ring-y −1.15)
options.crown: When rim, the petal tube takes the --fx-rim color, default is the same color as the body
options.radius · band: Ring radius · band height (world units, based on object height 2.2), default 1.55 · .2
options.tilt · roll: Angle the ring tilts toward the screen · angle skewed off the screen (deg), default 30 · −12 — at 0 it’s a band seen from the side
options.fps: Draw frequency (per second), default 0 = Every frame — at 30 it draws only half, leaving room for interaction responses and other motion
options.class=\"fx-hold\": <html> While this class is on, drawing stops (while a menu or dialog covering the panel is open) — drawing resumes when it is removed
options.spin · bob: One head turn (sec) · bounce height, default 14 · .06
options.--fx-rim: Light and tube color from behind and below, default --kf-accent
options.--fx-key: Front light and goggle color, default --kf-ink
options.color: Ring text color follows the element’s color

note: three loads three.cjs after three-global.js as a regular <script> Loaded in. The original layers an alpha video (mascot) and Lottie (rotating text ring, Gilroy letterforms) — we built the same scene with our own shapes and our own light. Drawing stops when the stage is off screen.
